dynamic_route.disposition: Routes remain available and describe one remote service. Each city route points its canonical to https://auditweb.site/website-audit-services/. No noindex or redirect was added.
dynamic_route.rationale: The city pages are close variants of the same remote offer and do not contain evidence for a distinct local offer. Canonical consolidation preserves the URLs while identifying the main service page as representative.
dynamic_route.limitations: City name, region and country support scoping and navigation only. The pages do not claim an office, local audit history, city-specific performance data or local market expertise.
